name: Hyprland
description: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks.
one_liner: A highly customizable way to arrange windows on a Linux desktop, with smooth animations and visual polish, for people who want a nicer-looking, tiling-window-manager-style setup.
buyer: This is a hobbyist power-user tool for Linux desktop enthusiasts, not something most businesses would ever buy — there isn't a real commercial buyer here.
business_use_cases: A Linux-focused YouTuber or streamer builds content (setup tours, ricing tutorials) around configuring it, monetized through the content platform, not the tool itself.
A boutique Linux hardware reseller pre-configures and ships laptops with a polished Hyprland setup as a selling point for enthusiast buyers.

money_ideas.idea: Selling pre-made, polished configuration themes/dotfiles bundles to enthusiasts who want the look without the setup effort.

steal_this: Package and sell a single polished, ready-to-install config theme this weekend to the enthusiast community — a tiny, honest niche product, not a real business.
